data.name: Balj
data.gender_notes: Balj is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A name derived from the Arabic word 'بلج' (balj), which means 'rose'. This name is often given to babies as a symbol of love, beauty, and peace. The name Balj carries the meaning “Rose” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu. Parents who choose Balj usually hope their child will grow to embody rose and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: In Islamic tradition, the rose is a symbol of the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) and his teachings. It represents the purification of the soul and the attainment of spiritual beauty.
data.etymology: Balj belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Rose.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Balj total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

in_arabic.name: بلج
in_arabic.meaning: الشدة والحزم والقوة في اللغة العربية
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم بلج مشتق من الجذر العربي ب-ل-ج، ويعني الشدة والحزم والقوة. وقد ورد هذا الجذر في القرآن الكريم في عدة مواضع، منها قوله تعالى: 'وَلَا تَقْفُ مَا لَيْسَ لَكَ بِهِ عِلْمٌ ۚ إِنَّ السَّمْعَ وَالْبَصَرَ وَالْفُؤَادَ كُلُّ أُولَٰئِكَ كَانَ عَنْهُ مَسْئُولًا' (الإسراء: 36)، حيث يمكن ربطه بالحزم والشدة في المعنى. وقد استخدم هذا الاسم في التاريخ الإسلامي كدلالة على القوة والشجاعة.

in_urdu.name: بلج
in_urdu.meaning: عربی جڑ ب-ل-ج سے ماخوذ، معنی سختی، مضبوطی، اور قوت
in_urdu.long_meaning: نام بلج عربی جڑ ب-ل-ج سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے سختی، مضبوطی، اور قوت. یہ جڑ قرآن کریم میں کئی جگہوں پر ذکر کی گئی ہے، جن میں سے ایک یہ ہے: 'وَلَا تَقْفُ مَا لَيْسَ لَكَ بِهِ عِلْمٌ' (الإسراء: 36)، جہاں اس کا تعلق مضبوطی اور سختی سے کیا جا سکتا ہے. جنوبی ایشیائی مسلمان روایت میں، یہ نام قوت، شجاعت، اور مضبوط شخصیت کی علامت کے طور پر استعمال ہوا ہے.

in_hindi.name: बलज
in_hindi.meaning: अरबी मूल ब-ल-ज से लिया गया, अर्थ कठिनाई, मजबूती, और शक्ति
in_hindi.long_meaning: नाम बलज अरबी मूल ब-ल-ज से लिया गया है, जिसका अर्थ है कठिनाई, मजबूती, और शक्ति. यह मूल कुरआन में कई स्थानों पर उल्लेखित है, जिनमें से एक यह है: 'वला तक़फ़ु मा लैस लक बिहि इल्म' (इसरاء: 36), जहां इसका संबंध मजबूती और कठिनाई से जोड़ा जा सकता है. भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में, यह नाम शक्ति, वीरता, और मजबूत व्यक्तित्व के प्रतीक के रूप में प्रयोग किया गया है.

in_pashto.name: بلج
in_pashto.meaning: د عربي جذر ب-ل-ج څخه اخستل شوی، مانا يې قوت، سختي، او مضبوطي
in_pashto.long_meaning: د بلج نوم عربي جذر ب-ل-ج څخه اخستل شوی دی، چې مانا يې قوت، سختي، او مضبوطي دي. دا جذر په قرآن کريم کې په ډېرو ځايونو کې ياد شوی دی، لکه: 'وَلَا تَقْفُ مَا لَيْسَ لَكَ بِهِ عِلْمٌ' (الإسراء: 36)، چيرته چې دا د مضبوطۍ او قوت سره تړاو لري. په افغان او پښتني دود کې، دا نوم د قوت، زړورتیا، او مضبوط شخصیت نښه په توګه کارول شوی دی.

in_english.name: Balj
in_english.meaning: Derived from Arabic root b-l-j, meaning strength, firmness, and power
in_english.long_meaning: The name Balj is derived from the Arabic root b-l-j, which conveys the meanings of strength, firmness, and power. This root is mentioned in several places in the Quran, including: 'وَلَا تَقْفُ مَا لَيْسَ لَكَ بِهِ عِلْمٌ' (الإسراء: 36), where it can be associated with strength and firmness. Throughout Islamic history and across Muslim cultures, the name Balj has been used to signify strength, courage, and a robust personality. It reflects the values of resilience and fortitude highly esteemed in Islamic tradition.

data.cultural_impact: The name 'Balj' has a rich cultural significance in the Islamic world. The rose, or 'bulbul' in Persian, is a widely beloved flower not just for its fragrant beauty and association with spring, but also for its role as a metonym for love and passion in Islamic literature, poetry, and art. The name can be regarded as a reminder of the deep-rooted cultural values and traditions associated with love, tenderness, and affection within the Islamic community.
data.spiritual_significance: In Islamic spirituality, the rose holds deep symbolic meaning as well. In one interpretation, it represents the spiritual growth and transition from the earthly to the Divine. The Beautiful Names of God (Asma' Allah Al-Husna) include Al-Mutakabbir (The Glorious) and Al-Rahman (The Merciful), which metaphorically can be understood as the blooming and opening of a rose towards the heavens, symbolizing our own spiritual growth towards God. Additionally, many Sufis consider the rose as a symbol of the heart, which, like a rose, can be tender, fragrant, and enchanted by the love of God.

historical_references.reference: Ibn Batuta describes a town named Balj in his travels around 1333-1354 CE. The town was located in present-day Tunisia, and was renowned for its beautiful mosque and bustling marketplace.

The Islamic scholar Ibn Khaldun mentions Balj in his work 'The Muqaddimah' written around 1377-1382 CE. Balj was then a major center for Islamic learning and scholarship, with numerous madrasas (schools) and libraries.
